name: Grand Marché de Niamey
subtitle: The primary commercial center of Niger, home to thousands of stalls trading Sahelian textiles, spices, and leathercraft.

facts.label: Established
facts.value: 1950; modernized and rebuilt following a major fire in 1982

facts.label: Goods
facts.value: Sahelian fabrics, Tuareg leatherwork and silver jewelry, local produce, and spices

parts.text: The Grand Marché de Niamey is the commercial pulse of Niger. Rebuilt in 1982 with modern covered halls and fire-prevention corridors, the market hosts thousands of traders selling colorful wax fabrics, traditional Tuareg leather cushions, hand-forged silver Agadez crosses, pottery, and spices arriving via caravan routes and Niger River transport.
